options.name: Removed archpatriarch political influence
options.desc: The Archpatriarch's ties with the government have been permanently cut-off. His domain is now strictly religious.

options.name: Contained Archpatriarch authority
options.desc: The archpatriarch's government requires an ecclesial vote of confidence and the decrees cannot override existing legislation, unless the Eclesia issues an emergency state.

options.name: Broad Archpatriarch prerogatives
options.desc: The archpatriarch is the head of the state, the government and the Graic Church. He possesses the authority to appoint and remove ministers, and the ability to issue decrees.
